إِذَا زُلۡزِلَتِ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ زِلۡزَالَهَا
When the earth is shaken with its [final] earthquake
When the earth is rocked with a terrible quake
When the earth will be shaken vigorously, which will happen to it on the Day of Judgement.
بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ إِذَا زُلْزِلَتِ الْأَرْضُ زِلْزَالَهَا
وَأَخۡرَجَتِ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ أَثۡقَالَهَا
And the earth discharges its burdens
and discharges its burdens
And the earth will remove everything from within itself, i.e. the dead and other things.
وَأَخْرَجَتِ الْأَرْضُ أَثْقَالَهَا
وَقَالَ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ مَا لَهَا
And man says, "What is [wrong] with it
and man says, ‘What is the matter with her?’
And the human will say, confused: “What is the matter with the earth, that it is moving and shaking?”
وَقَالَ الْإِنْسَانُ مَا لَهَا
يَوۡمَئِذࣲ تُحَدِّثُ أَخۡبَارَهَا
That Day, it will report its news
On that day she will relate her chronicles
On that great day, the earth will inform regarding the good and evil deeds that were committed upon it.
يَوْمَئِذٍ تُحَدِّثُ أَخْبَارَهَا
بِأَنَّ رَبَّكَ أَوۡحَىٰ لَهَا
Because your Lord has commanded it
for her Lord will have inspired her
Because Allah will have taught it and commanded it to do so.
بِأَنَّ رَبَّكَ أَوْحَىٰ لَهَا
يَوۡمَئِذࣲ يَصۡدُرُ ٱلنَّاسُ أَشۡتَاتࣰ ا لِّيُرَوۡاْ أَعۡمَٰلَهُمۡ
That Day, the people will depart separated [into categories] to be shown [the result of] their deeds
On that day, mankind will issue forth in various groups to be shown their deeds
On that great day on which the earth will quake, the humans will come to of the place of reckoning in groups, to see the deeds they committed in the world.
يَوْمَئِذٍ يَصْدُرُ النَّاسُ أَشْتَاتًا لِيُرَوْا أَعْمَالَهُمْ
فَمَن يَعۡمَلۡ مِثۡقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيۡرࣰ ا يَرَهُۥ
So whoever does an atom's weight of good will see it
So whoever does an atom’s weight of good will see it
So whoever did a good or righteous deed equal to the weight of a small ant, will see it in front of him.
فَمَنْ يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيْرًا يَرَهُ
وَمَن يَعۡمَلۡ مِثۡقَالَ ذَرَّةࣲ شَرࣰّ ا يَرَهُۥ
And whoever does an atom's weight of evil will see it
and whoever does an atom’s weight of evil will see it
And whoever did an evil deed equal to that, will see that in front of him also.
وَمَنْ يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ شَرًّا يَرَهُ
